test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 12 April 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Six friends, David, Bhanu, Minto, Krita, John and Nisan, are sitting in a circle with their backs towards the centre. David and Minto are sitting to the immediate left and right of Bhanu, respectively. John is not sitting to the immediate left of David. Nisan is sitting third to the right of Bhanu. Who is sitting second to the left of Bhanu?
solution:
Six friends,** David, Bhanu, Minto, Krita, John and Nisan,** are sitting in a circle with their backs towards the centre. 

1. David and Minto are sitting to the immediate left and right of Bhanu, respectively. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6fe2d3f06879920439238901fd4577af0592cbec62812777c2c2e2ca0f27768e.png] 

2. John is not sitting to the immediate left of David. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7564dc1127f1f1acd1cabaca1e5e2547147c43cc9ccdf842940655ca45700e3a.png] 

3. Nisan is sitting third to the right of Bhanu. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9fa4e772834639a75c264bcf67a4bb513e01e5fce8c9e2891febbc8ca8b8b2a8.png] 

Clearly, John is sitting immediate right of Minto as it is the only vacant position John can occupy and Krita is sitting exactly opposite to Minto.

So the arrangement will be as shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cf71f28084f2e49c98c871c25489eb7245a70b9fd0858507fd69a23d9b864891.png] 

Clearly, Krita is sitting second to the left of Bhanu.

Hence, ‘**Krita**’ is the correct answer.
